role.altitude: The biochemist keeps planning gene studies, doing the lab work and interpreting expression results; running analysis programs one by one and writing up notebook entries shrink.
skills_to_grow: Running and checking versioned analysis pipelines
role.ambitious_version: A biochemist who has expression results the day sequencing data arrive.

tasks.short: Plan the study, do the lab work to investigate the nature, composition or expression of genes or the impact of genetic engineering, run sequencing data through the pipeline, interpret the results and record them.

steps.what: Biochemist plans the gene expression or genetic engineering study
Biochemist does the lab work: cloning, gene editing and RNA extraction
Biochemist runs sequencing data through the analysis steps
Biochemist records methods and findings in the lab notebook

tasks.design: Sequencing files delivered by the facility start a versioned community pipeline with tests, which produces quality reports and expression tables, so the biochemist checks reports instead of running each program. Pipeline versions and parameters are attached to the notebook entry automatically. Planning, lab work and interpretation stay with the biochemist; genetic engineering work runs under the lab's existing permit.
tasks.previous_blocker: Each dataset was analysed with hand-run scripts.
tasks.enabler_now: Versioned community pipelines with containers and tests.
tasks.still_hard: Unexpected results that need new analyses.
tasks.human_edge: Seeing which change in expression matters biologically.
tasks.altitude: Less hand analysis; lab work and insight stay.

reach.learn: Whether fewer ad hoc requests come in.

evidence.claim: Community bioinformatics pipelines have tagged releases, containers and tests.
Frontier models reached 17% accuracy on open-answer bioinformatics analyses, so analysis stays in tested code.
Genetic engineering work needs a permit under the GMO rules.

assumptions: Boundary: one gene study from plan to recorded findings; publication is outside.
Input contract for s3: sequencing files delivered by the facility in standard format for standard library types, about 80% of runs; others need custom analysis; s3 is priced at that share.
Planning, lab work and interpretation keep their full time.
s5 keeps 80: pipeline versions and parameters attach automatically, while the biochemist writes the methods and findings.
unknowns: Share of studies needing custom analysis.
research_questions: Does time from sequencing to results fall?

incremental.description: Biochemist updates pipeline versions with bioinformatics support.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: half of the runs use non-standard library types that need custom analysis, so s3 keeps 69 (7.7); high: about 80% standard runs as assumed (11.5).

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional
